question: What on-disk header and versioning does Apple PaperKit use, and which MarkupError case is thrown for each failure class?
reason: Linux accepts only the OPKM v1 archive and maps unknown magic to incorrectFormat, version>1 to incompatibleFormatTooNew, and truncated/invalid JSON to malformedData. Apple bytes are never decoded as success.
